item.title: Version 3.2.0
item.description:
• PrayerTimes Pro comes to the direct download. The adhan library, spoken pre-prayer announcements, adhan volume, the prayer log with streaks and qada, the sun-path arc and the Ramadan cannon, the Siri "Next Prayer" shortcut, and five of the six accent colours are now part of a one-time unlock. **If you have been using the direct build, everything you already had stays yours, permanently and at no cost** — nothing you use today is taken away
  • Unlock with a licence key: paste it and it activates by itself, verifying on screen character by character. The licence works offline, and you can reveal, copy or re-check it any time under Settings ▸ PrayerTimes Pro
  • PrayerTimes Pro is its own settings page now rather than half of About, so what it costs and what it unlocks sit in one place instead of under the version number
  • About gained links to the roadmap, the website and support, and its privacy disclosure is now three plain cards instead of a wall of text
  • The setup guide ends with a short offer you can skip in one click
  • Emerald stays free for everyone. Light, Dark and System themes stay free too — only the other five accent colours are part of Pro
  • Anonymous crash reports, **on by default — turn them off any time**. The setup guide surfaces the choice, and Settings ▸ General ▸ Diagnostics changes it whenever you like. Never your location, prayer log or licence key. The Mac App Store build is unchanged and continues to use Apple's own reporting
  • Anonymous usage counts share that same Diagnostics switch — how often the app launches, not what you pray or where. A handful of integrity signals (a licence key that fails its format check, for example) are still sent when the switch is off, which is what the Diagnostics footer has always said
  • The popover footer is five icon cells now — Qibla, Calendar, Pro, Settings and Quit — drawn from the design rather than a summary of it. Quitting no longer means going back through the menu bar
  • The setup guide gained a Run at Login switch, and its Calculation & alerts step scrolls instead of clipping its own header off the top
  • Settings behaves when resized: it stops at a sensible minimum instead of collapsing to a sliver, fills the window in right-to-left layouts instead of leaving a dead strip, and a window restored too small grows back to usable
  • A revealed licence key hides itself again after ten seconds, so a credential does not sit open on an unattended Mac
  • Arabic, Persian and Urdu: the Pro screens are translated and laid out right-to-left, and the unlock button no longer clips its own label
  • Siri and Shortcuts answer "Next Prayer" in the app's language. The prayer and the time used to be joined by an English "at" whatever language you ran — "المغرب at 7:34 PM" — and the Pro message stayed English even where the rest of the answer was translated
  • The panel stays on screen and stops flipping to the other side of the menu-bar icon, and marking a prayer no longer makes it shake
  • The Qibla needle settles like a magnetised one instead of stopping dead on the bearing
  • When macOS hides the menu-bar icon, the app now explains what happened and how to get it back, instead of warning that something is wrong
  • "Use my location" works from the setup guide even when a city has already been set
